Title: Enhanced autoscale capabilities added to HDInsight clusters

Body.Content: Azure HDInsight has made notable improvements in stability and latency on Autoscale. The essential changes include improved feedback loop for scaling decisions, significant improvement on latency for scaling and support for recommissioning the decommissioned nodes. Learn more about the enhancements, and how to custom configure and migrate your cluster to enhanced autoscale.
